notes: Summary: Long engagement (~5 months). Heavy POC interest early; workload: chat/support agent + doc search + shipment summarization. Latency target: p95 50-75ms for chat; throughput peaks ~200 concurrent chat sessions, embedding jobs nightly. Cost sensitivity moderate; expected ARR in $250k-$500k band. Key win criteria for Sable: 1) full IAM/KMS integration inside their AWS org, 2) consolidated billing and CloudTrail/S3 log path, 3) legal-friendly data residency and audit logs. What happened: Security + Procurement prioritized consolidating inference under AWS managed endpoints (centralized IAM/KMS, existing enterprise support contract, cloud credits). Despite Redwood meeting most technical asks (demo latency, dedicated capacity options, on-prem offer), procurement wouldn't bend on single-vendor policy. No effective internal champion after VP of Ops moved roles in December which slowed negotiations and removed urgency. Quote from CTO on 2026-01-12 call: "We can't introduce another inference vendor into our org; billing & KMS must be under our AWS org." Next actions: archive opportunity, capture post-mortem learnings, keep in slate for future outreach if AWS experience proves limiting. Possible re-engage triggers: AWS managed outage impacting inference SLAs, AWS pricing change, internal re-organization creating new AI platform team.
